title: Documents
description: The files of “{{name}}”: pages, PDFs, Word files, images, sounds…

empty.title: Add files
empty.hint: Or drop them here: your whole chapter (one image per page), the PDF, the script in Word… They are encrypted with the project.

dropHint: Drop files on this card to add them. Enter: open · F2: rename · Alt+↑/↓: reorder.
replaced: “{{name}}” replaced. The previous file is kept in the versions.

actions.openExternalHint: Opens the file in its application (Word, Acrobat, Clip Studio…). Every save there comes back here automatically.
actions.newTextHint: Create a text (script, dialogue…) to write in GANIS

dialogs.saveAs: Save a copy of the document

external.hint: Every save there comes back here (the previous content stays in the versions). This working copy is not encrypted: click “Finish” when you are done.

reading.hint: Continuous reading of the images, in the order below.

viewer.wordPreview: Text preview: the exact layout (fonts, margins) is visible in Word.
viewer.wordUnreadable: This Word file cannot be displayed. Open it in its application.
viewer.saved: “{{name}}” saved. The previous version is kept.
viewer.noPreview: No preview for this file type
viewer.noPreviewHint: Open it in its application: your saves there will come back into the project.
viewer.unsafeHint: This file type could start a program: GANIS will not open it. You can save a copy.

versions.title: Versions of “{{name}}”
versions.description: Each replacement, edit in another application or saved text keeps the previous content (20 versions at most). Restoring keeps the current content first.

note.title: Note on “{{name}}”
note.description: A reminder for yourself: pages to redo, version sent to the publisher…

move.title: File “{{name}}” in…
move.description: The document goes to the end of the chosen item's documents.
move.label: Structure item
